Understood — I'll run only the standard freeze-drying demo with the registered lyo.kv_rp model, under its default assumptions, with no interpretation request and no equipment action.

What I'm submitting:
1. Load the standard demo context (technology-transfer example). This is the published/reconstructed demo; its observations are synthetic reconstructions, not plant data, and I will keep them clearly labeled as such.
2. Prepare a single-model pipeline using only lyo.kv_rp (quasi-steady Kv–Rp, unqualified engineering demonstration). Defaults throughout: no calibration, default evidence cutoff (6 h), interface-temperature observable, 4 samples, seed 2025, capped at 32 solver calls and 30 s wall time. This model has no required thermal inputs, so no thermal assumptions are invented; note it inherently neglects sensible-heat dynamics. Numerical completion is not residual moisture, potency or release suitability. No equipment changes will be proposed or executed; any follow-up would go to human review only.
